stock: 205 R16 or 215/80R16 on 16x5.5 steel wheels, depending on model

wheel.offset: ET63 or ET38 on the factory 16x5.5 fitments

max_tire.note: An Expedition Portal owner runs 235/85R16s on standard steel wheels on a short-wheelbase G. Many owners stay near 215/85R16 because the naturally aspirated diesels struggle with bigger tires. For 33s, plan on lift springs.

timeline.change: W460 goes on sale in September with petrol and diesel engines and short- and long-wheelbase bodies, hand-built in Graz
Deliveries to the German riot police and Federal Border Guard; a 230 G Cabriolet becomes the Popemobile
Automatic gearbox, air conditioning, auxiliary fuel tank, headlamp guards and winch added to the options list
Fuel-injected 230 GE replaces the carburetted 230 G; Swiss Army tender won
Jacky Ickx and Claude Brasseur win the Paris–Dakar car category in a 280 GE
Front and rear differential locks, central locking and a tachometer become standard
More than 50,000 G models built; Italy-market 200 GE added
The civilian W463 takes over; the military and commercial line continues as the W461

identify.intro: Many W460s have been re-engined, converted or federalised. Make sure the truck is the model, year and spec the seller says it is.

items.head: Chassis number
items.body: Chassis numbers on Bring a Trailer-sold W460s start with the 460 model code: a 1986 300 GD is WDB460333…, a 1984 230 GE Cabriolet WDB460218…. Earlier trucks often show the number without the WDB prefix (e.g. 460333…).

items.head: Lockers
items.body: Mercedes made front and rear diff locks standard on every W460 from 1985, so earlier trucks may not have them. Look for the locker control on the dash and the slave cylinders on the axles. A W460 never has a centre lock.

items.head: Part-time 4WD
items.body: The front axle is engaged by lever through the transfer case, with high and low range. Permanent 4WD means you're looking at a W463 or a W461 with W463 running gear.

items.head: Engine swaps
items.body: Turbodiesel OM603/OM606 and even GM V8 swaps turn up regularly on Bring a Trailer. BaT has sold OM606-powered 300 GDs for $69,696 and $79,500. Check the engine number against the model badge and know what you're paying for.

items.head: Puch badging
items.body: In Austria and some other markets the G was sold as a Puch. A Puch-badged truck is still a G, just with a different badge (and on Puch W461s, a VAG chassis prefix).

capability.v: 79 mph (127 km/h) 300 GD; 103 mph (165 km/h) 280 GE

values.intro: Diesel W460s are now proper US collector trucks. Rust, records and engine swaps make a bigger difference to the price than which model it is.
values.note: Based on 34 sold Bring a Trailer auctions from January 2025 to October 2026 ($11,550–$86,000, median about $32,000). For UK reference, Classic & Sports Car's guide puts pre-1990 hardtops at £5,000 (restoration), £14,000 (average) and £27,000+ (show), and soft-tops at £12,000, £30,000 and £75,000+.

docs.note: Covers most cars built 1986–2010, so later W460s only; €130 through the Mercedes-Benz Classic Store

paragraphs: Mercedes never sold the W460 new in the US. Grey-market specialists federalised some in the 1980s, until the 1988 Imported Vehicle Safety Compliance Act made that much harder. Every W460 is now more than 25 years old, and NHTSA lets any vehicle that old be imported, counted from its date of manufacture and declared under Box 1 of the HS-7 form. Check your state's titling and emissions rules before you buy one abroad.

production.intro: The W460 was built in Graz from 1979 to 1991, and more than 50,000 Gs were built in its first seven years.
